integrity.claim_scope: Deterministic structural identifiability and universal feasible minimal three-environment design only
integrity.computation: Exact-rational independent checker, 2500 admissible grid cases; finite checks not a replacement for proof
integrity.proof: Algebraic positive-equilibrium balance, rank equivalence and a strict equilibrium monotonicity derivative
integrity.provenance: The directed-dispersal model and its equilibrium response are explicitly credited to the cited primary source.

scientific_limitations: Exact, known habitat fractions and disturbance rates; only positive stationary occupancies are analyzed.
The three biological parameters remain constant across surveyed landscapes and each configuration follows the normalized globally mixed Levins directed-dispersal mechanism.
No claim of robust finite-sample estimation, detection correction, transient identification, or field implementation.
Historical priority is provisional: source-model supplementary appendix and a broader general framework were not accessible in complete technical text.
title: A sharp three-survey identifiability law for directed metapopulation dispersal
